title: 🔥 NEW R22 Pilot Experience Pack + Bell 407 & Baron Cockpit Liveries! MSFS PC Update
description:
In today’s MSFS Marketplace Update, we explore the highly anticipated Pilot Experience Pack R22 for PC. This brand-new Robinson R22 helicopter experience pack offers an enhanced training and flying experience for MSFS 2020 pilots. We also dive into the latest MSFS new liveries and cockpit upgrades from 2PILOT.

If you are looking for the best MSFS helicopter add-on or the latest MSFS 2020 new aircraft, this weekly update covers everything added to the MSFS PC Marketplace this April.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 DHM: Pilot Experience Pack R22 (Enhanced Robinson R22 training & flying experience)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 2PILOT: NEW COCKPIT BARON/BONANZA & LONGITUDE WHITE (Clean white cockpit interior upgrade)
🎨 2PILOT: NEW COCKPIT G2 BELL 407 DR400 (Updated cockpit styling for added immersion)
